videos.title: Nothing Is As It Seems
videos.overview: Doctors overrule foul play on the mysterious death of Richard White, patriarch of Margao's wealthy family. Yet Richard's family harbors deep suspicions after his will reveals unsettling secrets.

videos.title: Any Meat IS Tasty...
videos.overview: Convinced of her daughter in law Samantha's involvement in Richard's death, his wife Sylvia White hires detective Rose Braganza to investigate. A suicide in the neighborhood complicate matters.

videos.title: One Lock. Many Keys!
videos.overview: The Margao police team, headed by officer Varsha Salgaoncar, investigates the alleged suicide that uncovers buried secrets of the neighboring White family. Are the two deaths connected?

videos.title: Murder Is Delicious!
videos.overview: As the police near the conclusion of their investigation into the white family’s clandestine relationships and betrayals, another prominent individual of the Margao community is found dead.

videos.title: Murders Are Easy
videos.overview: Are the three deaths in fifteen days merely coincidental? Amid the ongoing pandemic, could a perpetrator be exploiting the situation to their advantage? The investigation is underway.

videos.title: Women! Don't Tell Lies Darling
videos.overview: With Richard White's daughter, Marjorie Rodrigues, entwined in a web of dark secrets and occult practices, suspicion falls on everyone. Officer Varsha and Detective Rose are convinced the killer is hiding among them.

videos.title: Killing Is The Best Sport
videos.overview: The family lawyer succumbs to a deadly poisoning, unravelling the chilling conspiracy to eliminate Richard. Betrayal hangs in the air.

videos.title: Truth Is An Illusion
videos.overview: Even as the case seems solved, whispers of a deeper conspiracy hint that the true mastermind still orchestrates a deadly gambit, leaving everyone on edge.
